title: Kamishiro Rui — Words Overheard〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Phew. I'm finally done doing maintenance on these props.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I never thought that we'd get a chance to appear in a film.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: The movie I'm about to work on is also going to include a few others from Shunmeiza...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
But they still need more extras.
So, if you'd like, would you all like to apply to be in it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We decided to apply to become extras after hearing about it from Bakuno...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But we ended up celebrating after we found out that we'd been accepted.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah! Wonderlands×Showtime will be making its big debut on the silver screen!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, this is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know we're just gonna be playing roles like a girl having a picnic or a man admiring flowers, but we should still do our best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed. We may be extras, but we're still going to be people who live in the world of the story...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm going to do the best job I can of squatting while admiring flowers as Young Man A!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Incidentally, I just found out that Bakuno will be performing in the scene we appear in.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Screen acting is supposed to be way different from stage acting, but I can't wait to see how Bakuno does.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, me too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to seeing how films are actually made♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know we're only gonna be on set for a day, but I wanna learn as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like we're all looking forward to this experience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Emu's brothers gave us a chance to work with Shunmeiza, and now we've been given this opportunity thanks to one of their actors...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, we're lucky to have been able to establish such a network.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (On top of learning as much as we can from the opportunities they've given us, I hope we get to repay everyone someday...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, I'll go through the script one last time before I go to bed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The film we're going to be a part of is being directed by someone called Tomomi Ohara.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (After doing some quick research, I found that he doesn't employ big plot twists or anything of the sort in his films. His works seem to be mostly subdued stories that carefully explore his characters' feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Including this one. The protagonist has all but given up on life, but someone calling herself his long-lost sister suddenly appears before him. And he begins to change as a result. It's a drama that explores human relationships.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which explains why he asked Bakuno to play the protagonist. This kind of story is his forte.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What we saw him do on stage was spectacular, to put it mildly.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (His performance made his character feel like a real-life person...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Just like Nene, I'm also looking forward to seeing what he does for this film.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (As well as how he and the director are going to work together.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we were to turn this film into a show, how would I go about doing that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The climax is obviously the most exciting part, but the entire story is remarkably mellow and subdued. Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The backdrops for the stage would also need to be fairly simple. But we could make it so that they change little by little as the protagonist's feelings evolve over time...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Where the characters stand would also play a crucial role. They'd start out far apart, but move closer together as they get to know one another...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I really got ahead of myself there...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I just can't help but think about how to put on a good show.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, I want to take what I can from this film and use it to learn how to put on better performances...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We won't be there for very long, but I'd like to make the most of this experience.
